    Coverage

Definition
    The spatial or temporal topic of the resource, spatial applicability of the resource, or jurisdiction under which the resource is relevant.

Comment
    Spatial topic and spatial applicability may be a named place or a location specified by its geographic coordinates. Temporal topic may be a named period, date, or date range. Lexical collocations – salient co-occurrences of two lexical items (for a full deﬁnition and
literature review, see Bartsch, 2004) – form a subtype of the larger family of lexicalized
MWE and are notoriously diﬃcult to delineate due to the fuzzy nature of the linguis-

transparent to a large degree, although many collocations carry additional, often domain-
